VAL-BOOK-006.observed: On /acme/reservations/today (2026-10-16) the Walk-in dialog listed table G9-1 (tbl_ffa285d6-ea3b-4aad-8426-353588700a98, whose Dinner service-availability rule I set to walk_in_only) among the selectable tables. Seated party size 2 with guest name 'G9 Walkin Guest' and phone +15555550901 at G9-1: the browser sent POST http://localhost:3007/operator/reservations/book/walk-ins (Idempotency-Key walkin-8b32e048-294b-4787-a2a1-639f3cc74624) and received 201. The created row rsv_23bf40e5-4116-41a0-801b-4b86c65417c7 (confirmation R76QJ9) has channel='walk_in', status='seated', arrived_at=seated_at=1792194122512, covers_actual=2, assignment='locked', tableIds=[G9-1], and an active rsv_table_occupancies row (active=1, overbook=0, 1792194060000..1792198560000); events 'created' and 'seated' were appended, and the Today 'Walk-Ins Today' KPI updated to 2 covers / 1 walk-in party. The walk_in_only guarantee on the availability side was checked at the implemented surfaces: GET /operator/reservations/book/availability for Dinner party 2 never suggests the walk_in_only table (suggestedTableIds = [tbl_ceefa44b-...] only; G9-1 absent), the booking service filters walk_in_only tables out for phone/host channels (rsv-booking-service.ts:827-842), and @repo/reservations isModeAllowedForChannel (day-state.ts:157-168) excludes walk_in_only for guest channels (foundation-tested).
VAL-BOOK-006.notes: Two naming/coverage caveats, neither changing the behavior: (1) the contract says source='walk_in', but rsv_reservations has no source column in the shipped schema; walk-ins are stored and returned as channel='walk_in' (the same value used by the API response and the day feed). (2) The public GET /reservations/availability route named in the contract is not implemented in foh-core: with Origin http://acme.menuza.test:3008 it answers 404 {"error":"Endpoint Not Found"} (tenant-api mounts /reservations with only /config and /holds). The online-never-offers-walk_in_only clause was therefore verified through the implemented equivalents above; the public route belongs to the later online-booking milestone.

The Today header button showed 'Unassigned & Conflicts 1'; the panel listed 'Active Conflicts 1 - G9 Overlap012 (2 guests) - 21:00 - table_overlap - Overlaps with G9 Booked011 on G9-3' with resolution controls (suggested reassign select + Assign) and rendered the 'Unassigned Reservations 0' and 'Automatic Reflow Notices 0' sections. VAL-BOOK-012.notes: The contract explicitly allows the overbooked-overlap example, which is what I used. The conflicts route was exercised with a real curl request against the running node (200); the App UI itself derives the panel from the day feed rather than calling /book/conflicts (no reference to that path exists in apps/app). I did not additionally force a genuinely unassigned booking: the reflow path that unassigns a party requires invalidating tables shared with other validators and triggers a location-wide reflow across other groups' business dates. The endpoint's unassigned array and the panel's unassigned section were exercised and rendered correctly (empty, count 0).

VAL-BOOK-037.observed:
PASSING parts: /acme/reservations/today?lng=ar, /acme/reservations/book?lng=ar&date=2026-10-16 and the detail sheet ?r=&lng=ar all set documentElement dir="rtl" lang="ar"; tabs and filters are Arabic ('اليوم', 'دفتر الحجوزات', 'الجدول الزمني', 'مخطط الصالة', 'التقويم', 'نظرة عامة', 'جميع الفترات', 'جميع المناطق'), quick-action buttons are Arabic ('وصل', 'إجلاس', 'التفاصيل', 'حضور مباشر', 'حجز جديد', 'غير المعينة والتعارضات 1'), the 'Late Risk' badge is Arabic ('خطر التأخير'), and a scan of the rendered text found zero raw Lingui message IDs. Number/code rendering is correct: per-character Range x-positions are strictly ascending for confirmation codes (RSVACM105: 840,847,854,862,869,876,883,890,898), times (12:30: 943,950,957,965,972; 21:00) and phone digits (+12125550145: 839..905), i.e. LTR order with no reversal; party numbers are single digits. The leading '+' of a phone number is placed at the right edge of the RTL run, which I reproduced on a neutral page with a bare
+15555550902
('+' at x=151, right of all digits) - standard Unicode bidi placement of a leading neutral, not digit reversal. Console errors after all Arabic flows: none (agent-browser errors empty). FAILING part: status badges are NOT translated - the Arabic UI still renders the raw English enum values 'booked', 'confirmed', 'arrived', 'seated', 'finished', 'no_show' and 'cancelled' in the Today/Book/Finished cards and the detail sheet, and the course-stage badge shows 'entree'. Neither en.po nor ar.po contains these enum strings, and the code renders {rsv.status} / {rsv.courseStage} directly (today.tsx:376, 507, 590; book.tsx:449, 453; detail-sheet.tsx:403), contradicting the contract's requirement that 'Arabic translations appear for tabs, filters, status badges, and action buttons' and the mission directive that enum badges go through Lingui. Additionally the breadcrumb on the Arabic page still shows English 'Reservations' and 'Today'.
VAL-BOOK-037.notes: Fail is scoped to the untranslated status/course badges (and the breadcrumb observation). Everything else the assertion lists - dir=rtl, translated tabs/filters/action buttons, no raw Lingui IDs, unreversed numbers/codes/times/parties, zero console errors - was verified and passes. Data-driven chips ('vip', 'tag_acme_anniversary', 'Severe tree nut allergy', table labels) are guest/configuration data rather than UI strings and were not counted against the assertion.

friction.description: The public availability route named by VAL-BOOK-006 (GET /reservations/availability with the Sites Origin) does not exist in foh-core: tenant-api's public reservations router mounts only /config and /holds, so the request answers 404 {"error":"Endpoint Not Found"}. The online-never-offers-walk_in_only clause could only be checked against the implemented equivalents (operator /book/availability exclusion, booking-service walk_in_only filtering, and the engine's isModeAllowedForChannel guest-channel gate).
friction.resolution: Verified the implemented equivalent surfaces and recorded the 404 explicitly in the report instead of treating the clause as untested.

friction.description: Contract wording vs schema: VAL-BOOK-006 requires source='walk_in' on the created reservation, but rsv_reservations has no source column (only rsv_holds does); walk-ins are stored and returned as channel='walk_in'.
friction.resolution: Treated channel='walk_in' as the implementation of the contract's source field and flagged the naming mismatch for synthesis.

friction.description: The Today screen's conflict panel and header badge are fed by the day feed; the App never calls GET /operator/reservations/book/conflicts, so the contract's 'network(GET .../conflicts -> 200)' evidence had to be captured with a direct curl request rather than from the browser session.
friction.resolution: Issued the real request against the running tenant-api node with a minted book token and saved the request/response as evidence.

friction.description: Forcing a genuinely unassigned reservation (to populate the conflicts endpoint's unassigned array) requires invalidating tables that other validators' bookings sit on; the setup reflow path recomputes every future date in the location (rsv-setup-service.ts reflowFutureBookingsForLocation builds datesSet from all upcoming reservations), which would have moved other groups' soft bookings on 2026-10-20/21/23-28 and 2026-11-02..05.
friction.resolution: Used the contract's explicitly allowed overbooked-overlap example instead and verified the unassigned path only at its empty-state level (endpoint field + panel section, count 0).

friction.description: agent-browser eval runs share one page context, so re-using a top-level `const` (e.g. `badge`) across calls throws 'Identifier has already been declared'; and a leading '+' phone number in RTL needed a bare-DOM control test to prove the placement is standard bidi behaviour rather than digit reversal.
friction.resolution: Wrapped each eval body in an IIFE, and added a minimal <div dir="rtl"> control measurement.

friction.description: The KSA Today screen opens on the live business date (2026-10-16) even after typing into the Day spinbutton; the date only sticks when passed as ?date=2026-10-22 (the useHostStand hook reads the search param).
friction.resolution: Navigated with ?date=2026-10-22 for every KSA screen and left the seeded 2026-10-17 rows untouched.

summary: Tested 5 assertions through the real surfaces (agent-browser on the App, curl on tenant-api, read-only sqlite3). VAL-BOOK-006 pass (walk-in seated on a walk_in_only table with channel='walk_in', status seated, arrived_at/seated_at, covers_actual 2, active occupancy; walk_in_only table never offered by availability - the public /reservations/availability route is not implemented in foh-core). VAL-BOOK-011 pass (Upcoming 4 / Seated 2 / Finished 3 badges matched the contract's status sets exactly, and the Seat quick action returned 200 and moved the row, updating counters to 3/3/3). VAL-BOOK-012 pass (overbooked overlap surfaced by GET /book/conflicts 200 as table_overlap, Today badge 'Unassigned & Conflicts 1', panel listed it with resolution controls, Details opened ?r=<id>). VAL-BOOK-036 pass (all KSA book traffic on 3009, KSA token refused by 3007 with 403 region_mismatch, rows only in the KSA DB, zero rows/PII for the phones, names, ids and codes in data.db and all US tenant DBs). VAL-BOOK-037 fail (dir=rtl, Arabic tabs/filters/buttons, no raw Lingui IDs, numbers/codes/times unreversed and zero console errors all verified, but status badges and the course-stage badge render raw English enums 'booked/confirmed/arrived/seated/finished/no_show/cancelled/entree' with no catalog entries, and the breadcrumb stays English). No product code was modified; git status is clean and the browser session was closed.
